answer_1.quote: CSC can be regarded as a revision task on Chinese sentences. Given a Chinese sentence X = {x 1 , x 2 , ..., x n } of length n, the model needs to detect spelling errors on character level and output its correct corresponding sentence Y = {y 1 , y 2 , ..., y n }.

answer_2.quote: Metrics including accuracy, precision, recall and F1 score are calculated for errors detection and correction, respectively.
